name: DIALOG
recent: Dialog Group Berhad 于2026年11月19日召开第38届常年股东大会，股东批准了包括每股3.0仙末期股息在内的所有议案，唯普通决议第9项被撤回。公司2026财年第一季度净利按年增长近18%，并正与相关方洽谈扩大Pengerang储油设施，同时计划减少固定价格合约以降低风险。
notable: 第38届常年股东大会通过每股3.0仙末期股息等议案，普通决议第9项被撤回。
2026财年第一季度净利按年增长近18%，公司预期上游和中游扩张将推动增长。
公司正洽谈扩大Pengerang储油设施，并计划减少固定价格合约。
risks: 普通决议第9项在常年股东大会上被撤回。
公司计划减少固定价格合约，此前相关业务出现亏损。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为7.746亿令吉，按季增长11.2%，按年增长27.3%；净利为1.675亿令吉，按季增长12.9%，按年增长13.6%；净利率为21.6%，高于上一季度的21.3%。

recent_en: Dialog Group Berhad held its 38th AGM on 19 Nov 2026, where shareholders approved all resolutions including a final single-tier dividend of 3.0 sen per share, except Ordinary Resolution 9 which was withdrawn. The company's 1Q net profit rose nearly 18% year-on-year, and it is in talks to expand its Pengerang storage facilities while planning to take on fewer fixed-price contracts to reduce risk.
notable_en: The 38th AGM approved a final single-tier dividend of 3.0 sen per share and other resolutions, while Ordinary Resolution 9 was withdrawn.
1Q net profit rose nearly 18% year-on-year, with the company expecting upstream and midstream expansion to drive growth.
The company is in talks to expand its Pengerang storage facilities and plans to take on fewer fixed-price contracts.
risks_en: Ordinary Resolution 9 was withdrawn at the AGM.
The company plans to take on fewer fixed-price contracts after losses in such jobs.
earnings_en: For 4Q FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was MYR774.6 million, up 11.2% QoQ and 27.3% YoY; net income was MYR167.5 million, up 12.9% QoQ and 13.6% YoY; net margin was 21.6%, up from 21.3% in the previous quarter.
